DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 金額の記入についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about entering an amount, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の取引のメモに三百とあります。円の欄にも三百と写しましたが、メモは円ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外貨三百を円欄へ三百と転記したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My notes for an overseas transaction say three hundred. I copied three hundred into the yen field too, but the notes aren't in yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you copied three hundred in foreign currency into the yen field as three hundred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の通貨と記録を確認しましょう。換算した金額は、別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the original currency and records. Do you have a converted amount separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだありません。数字だけを写し、通貨の名前を落としていました。こちらが元の明細です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 換算未実施で通貨名を省いた元明細を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I copied just the number and omitted the currency name. Here is the original statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the original statement, explaining that no conversion has been done and the currency name was omitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な換算や記入の方法は、内容と時期を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain the necessary conversion and entry method after checking the details and timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日ネットで見た数字を勝手に使うのでなく、どの時点の情報が必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己の最新ネット値でなく必要時点と方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than use a number I saw online today on my own, I'd like to ask what point in time the information needs to relate to.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the required reference date and method rather than using the latest online figure yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の日時が分かる資料もご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also prepare documents showing the transaction's date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この明細にあります。ただ、お金を受け取った日と仕事をした日が別なので、両方を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入金日と仕事日が異なる二日付を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: They're on this statement. But the date I received the money differs from the day I did the work, so I'll explain both separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two different dates of payment and work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入を直す前に、まだ分からない点をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before correcting the entry, please tell us anything you still don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。三百円の収入と断定せず、通貨、二つの日付、未換算の状態を伝えます。確認後の方法で記入し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 円収入と断定せず通貨日時未換算を説明し確認後訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't declare it to be income of three hundred yen; I'll explain the currency, both dates, and the fact it hasn't been converted. I'll reenter it using the method confirmed afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the currency, dates, and unconverted status without declaring yen income, and correct it after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料と記入状況を確認します。それでは、元の明細も一緒にご用意ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the documents and how the entry stands. Please prepare the original statement too. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日のご観光は、どんな過ごし方をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: How would you like to spend today's sightseeing?

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達が十か所の一覧をくれました。でも、全部回ることより、一人でゆっくり歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十か所一覧より一人でゆっくり歩く希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend gave me a list of ten places. But rather than visit them all, I'd like to walk slowly on my own.
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer walking slowly alone to completing the list of ten places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見たい所と、お休みの時間を分けて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's think separately about places you want to see and time for rest.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一覧の写真を見て二か所だけ気になりました。残りを行きたくないと判断したわけではなく、今日は急ぎたくありません。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二候補を選び他場所の否定ではなく急がない方針と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two places caught my interest when I looked at the photos on the list. It's not that I've decided I don't want to visit the others; I just don't want to rush today.
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose two options and explain that you are avoiding rushing, not rejecting the other places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りのご予定はございますか。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have plans for your return?

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方に宿へ戻ります。閉館までの時間をぎりぎりまで使うのではなく、途中で休む余裕を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕方宿へ戻り途中休憩の余裕を取りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll return to my accommodation in the late afternoon. Rather than use every last minute before closing, I'd like to leave room for breaks along the way.
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will return to your accommodation in the late afternoon and want time for breaks along the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 各施設の案内も確認して、無理のない範囲でお選びください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check each facility's information and choose within a comfortable range.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。静かそうな写真でも、今も人が少ないとは限らないので、その時の状況を見て寄るか決めます。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の静けさを現在混雑の保証とせず現状で判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if the photo looks quiet, it doesn't necessarily mean few people are there now, so I'll decide whether to stop by based on the situation at the time.
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that a quiet photograph does not guarantee current crowd levels and you will judge the actual situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一覧の施設をすべて予約しているわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: You haven't booked every facility on the list, correct?

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約はありません。今日は二か所を候補にし、歩いて疲れたら一か所でもよいことにします。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未予約で二候補を一か所に減らす柔軟さを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't made any reservations. I'll keep two places as options today, and if I get tired walking, I'll be happy with just one.
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have no bookings and can flexibly reduce two options to one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望に合わせて候補をご案内します。それでは、ご自分のペースでご旅行をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll suggest options that suit your wishes. Enjoy your trip at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業場の表示で、何か気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about the workshop signs that catches your attention?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 容器の札に四桁の数字があります。その年に作った物だと友達へ説明しましたが、意味を確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四桁管理札を製造年と未確認で友人へ話したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a four-digit number on a container tag. I told my friend it was the year the item was made, but I haven't checked its meaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you told your friend a four-digit control tag was a production year without confirming it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作業用の番号は、担当の説明でご確認ください。どの札でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the meaning of work numbers through the person in charge's explanation. Which tag is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路から見えるこの札です。手を伸ばして裏まで見るのでなく、ここから示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路から札を示し触って裏を見ることはしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one, visible from the passage. I'll point to it from here rather than reach out to look at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the tag from the passage and say you will not touch it to look at its back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 札には製造の管理に使う表示があります。各数字の意味は、担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The tag has information used for production control. Let's ask the person in charge what each number means.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今見た数字を、商品の熟成期間や値段に置き換えて話さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札数字を熟成期間や価格へ換算しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll avoid interpreting the number I saw as the product's aging period or price when talking about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not convert the tag's number into an aging period or price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見学の説明と、販売商品の表示は別にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check tour explanations separately from the labels on products for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。作業中の容器と売場の瓶が同じ物かも分からないので、番号だけでつなげません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器と売瓶を番号だけで同一品と結びつけないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I don't even know whether the container being worked on and the bottle in the shop are the same product, so I won't connect them by number alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not identify a workshop container and a sale bottle as the same product by number alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友達へは、どの部分を訂正されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which part will you correct when speaking to your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 製造年と言った部分です。管理用の表示だと聞いたことと、数字の詳しい意味はまだ不明なことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 製造年説明を訂正し管理表示と詳細不明を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The part where I said production year. I'll distinguish being told it is a control label from still not knowing the detailed meaning of the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the production-year explanation and distinguish a control label from its still-unknown detailed meaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 札を動かさず確認してくださりありがとうございます。それでは、担当の解説をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking without moving the tag. Enjoy the person in charge's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 準備のお手伝いに来てくださった方ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're the person who came to help with preparations, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。机を並べるよう頼まれました。近くの人も私の班だと思い、皆に場所を指示しかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 机並べ依頼から周囲へ班員として指示しかけたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was asked to arrange tables. I thought the nearby people were in my group too and nearly started directing everyone where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that after being asked to arrange tables, you nearly gave instructions to those around you as if they were your group. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当者を確認してから作業を進めましょう。どなたから頼まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's confirm the person in charge before proceeding. Who asked you?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付の方です。私一人の手伝いだと聞きましたが、班長を頼まれたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付の個人手伝い依頼で班長には任命されていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The receptionist. I was asked to help individually, not appointed group leader.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that reception asked you to help individually and did not appoint you leader. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 机の位置や、手伝う方の役割は責任者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The supervisor will check table positions and the roles of the helpers.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の考えで通路を狭くせず、配置の図を見て担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己配置で通路を狭めず配置図を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't narrow the passage with a layout of my own; I'll look at the layout diagram and check with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the layout diagram with the person in charge rather than narrow the passage through your own arrangement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 声をかけた方へも、役割を説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain your role to the people you spoke to as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。先ほどの指示は私の判断だったと伝えます。皆が私に従う必要があるとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先の指示は自己判断と周囲へ訂正し従う義務としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll tell them the earlier instructions were my own judgment. I won't say everyone has to follow me.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your earlier instructions to those around you as your own decision and say they are not obliged to follow you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備中に分からないことがあれば、作業を止めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're unsure of anything during preparations, stop work and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 置く位置が分かるまで机を動かしません。今日は手伝いとして参加し、全体の完成を私が承認するつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置確認まで動かさず全体承認者でもないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't move the tables until I know where to put them. I'm participating as a helper today; I don't intend to approve completion of the whole setup.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not move tables until the layout is confirmed and are not the person who approves the overall setup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 役割を確認してからお願いします。それでは、責任者の案内をお待ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm the roles first. Wait for the supervisor's guidance. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お召し上がりになる人数は、何名様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people will be eating?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と子どもです。一皿を分けたいですが、受け取ってから手で半分にするつもりにはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親子で一皿を分けたいが受取後に素手で分けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child and I. We'd like to share one plate, but I'm not planning to split it in half with my bare hands after receiving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that parent and child want to share one plate but will not divide it with bare hands after receiving it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分け方のご希望を伺います。お子様は、どのくらい召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask how you would like to share it. How much does your child eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少しだけです。大人と同じ量ではなく、食べられる量を見て取り分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子は少量で食べられる量を見て分けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a little. Rather than an adult-sized amount, I'd like to portion it out according to how much my child can eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your child eats only a little and you want to divide it according to how much they can eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 器や取り分けに使える物の取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the arrangements for dishes and things that can be used for sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。借りられる物があると決めず、必要なら自分の用意も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 器や道具を借りられると決めず必要な準備を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't assume there are things I can borrow; if necessary, I'll also think about what to prepare myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss the necessary preparations without assuming dishes or utensils can be borrowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料理は温かい状態でお渡しします。受取場所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll hand over the dish while it's hot. Please also check the pickup location.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。子どもに熱い皿をそのまま持たせず、私が受け取ります。食べる前に状態を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 熱い皿は親が受取り食前に状態を確かめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll receive the hot plate myself rather than give it straight to my child. I'll check its condition before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the parent will receive the hot plate and check its condition before eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お席については、共用場所の案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: For seating, please also check the guidance on shared areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を見てから落ち着ける場所へ移ります。分ける準備ができる前に、子どもへ今すぐ食べられると約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 共用場所を確認し分配準備前に即食の約束をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: After looking at the guidance, we'll move somewhere we can settle down. I won't promise my child they can eat immediately before we're ready to share the dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the shared area and will not promise immediate eating before sharing preparations are ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受取と取り分けのご希望を確認します。それでは、準備まで少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll confirm your wishes for pickup and sharing. Please wait a moment while we prepare. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車の前に、荷物についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about luggage before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この袋を高く持ち上げにくいです。扉の前で急にお願いするのでなく、今のうちに手伝える範囲を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物を高く上げにくく乗車前に支援範囲を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I find it difficult to lift this bag high. Rather than ask suddenly in front of the door, I'd like to ask now what help is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that lifting the luggage high is difficult and you want to ask about the extent of help before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの動作が難しいか、お教えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which movement is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平らな所では引いて運べます。段差で上げる時に困りますが、中に何があるかは係の方へ説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 平地は引けるが段差持上げが困難で内容は説明可能と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can pull it along flat ground. Lifting it over a step is difficult, but I can explain to staff what's inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can pull it on level ground but struggle to lift it over a step, and can explain its contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の置き方や、お手伝いの取扱いを担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about luggage placement and assistance arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。重さを軽いと見せかけて頼まず、自分が持てないことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 軽いと偽らず持上げ困難を正確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't pretend it is light when asking; I'll also explain that I can't lift it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accurately explain the lifting difficulty rather than falsely claim it is light. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご乗車の案内があるまで、通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the passage clear and wait for boarding guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。友達もいますが、無理に二人で上げればよいとは決めず、扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路外で待ち友人と無理に二人で上げないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. My friend is with me, but we won't assume that forcing ourselves to lift it together is the answer; we'll check how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait out of the passage and will not force a two-person lift with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中に、扱う際に注意が必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything inside that requires care when handling?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ガラス瓶が一つあります。袋の外からは見えないので先に話し、持ち方を決めてもらえるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋内のガラス瓶を先に申告し持ち方の相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: One glass bottle. It can't be seen from outside the bag, so I'll mention it first and ask whether you can help decide how to carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the glass bottle inside the bag in advance and discuss how to carry it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ状況を伝えます。それでは、荷物を置いたまま案内をお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about the situation. Please leave the luggage set down and wait for guidance. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様に関するご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about your child, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友達に嫌なことを言われたと聞きました。私が全部見た出来事のようには説明したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子から聞いた嫌な発言を親の全場面目撃として話さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I heard that a friend said something hurtful to them. I don't want to describe it as though I saw the entire incident myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will not present hurtful remarks reported by your child as something you personally witnessed in full. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で確認したことから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll start with what you've personally confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰宅後に子どもが泣いていたのは見ました。相手が何を言ったかは子どもから聞いた話です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親は泣く姿のみ観察し発言内容は子の説明と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw my child crying after coming home. What the other child said is something my child told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the parent seeing the crying from the remarks being the child's account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つを分けてお伝えください。記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us those two things separately. Do you have a record?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもが見せたメッセージがあります。でも、前後のやり取りを全部読んだわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メッセージはあるが前後全体は未読と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a message my child showed me. But I haven't read all the exchanges before and after it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have a message but have not read the entire surrounding exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の記録を残し、分からない部分も担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the original record, and tell the person in charge what you don't know too.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の言葉で書き直した画像だけにせず、元を残します。相手の意図まで決めて話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元記録を残し親の書直しや相手意図断定で代用しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than keep only an image rewritten in my words, I'll preserve the original. I won't decide what the other person intended when explaining it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the original record rather than replace it with the parent's rewrite or a conclusion about the other person's intentions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今のお子様のご希望も、聞ける範囲で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also ask about your child's current wishes as far as you're able to hear them.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもは、まず話を聞いてほしいと言っています。私が先に相手へ連絡して解決済みにするのでなく、相談方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子は傾聴希望で相手への先行連絡でなく相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: My child says they want someone to listen first. Rather than contact the other person myself in advance and call it resolved, I'd like to ask how to seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your child wants to be heard and ask how to consult rather than contact the other person first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した範囲とご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、ご相談の案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge what you've confirmed and your wishes. Please wait for consultation guidance. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの水とパンをお会計でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to pay for this water and bread?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。水は私の分で、パンは友達の分です。二点を一緒に払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己水と友人パンを二点一括会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The water is mine and the bread is my friend's. I'll pay for both items together.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay together for two items: your water and your friend's bread. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は一つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will one bag be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別々にお願いします。友達は疲れたので先に帰り、私はもう一軒寄ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別行動するため購入品を別袋にしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Separate bags, please. My friend is tired and will go home first, while I'll stop at another shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for separate bags because you and your friend are going separate ways. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。パンはこちらの小さい袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. I'll put the bread in this small bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。飲み物も選ぶ予定でしたが、友達が今日はパンだけでよいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は飲物を買わずパンのみ希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. We'd planned to choose a drink too, but my friend says just bread is enough today.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your friend wants only bread and will not buy a drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、二点でお会計します。お支払い方法はどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ring up the two items, then. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードでお願いします。レシートは私が持ちます。友達との精算は後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード払いと自己レシート保管と後日精算を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: By card, please. I'll keep the receipt. I'll settle up with my friend later.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay by card, keep the receipt yourself, and settle with your friend later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計が済みました。パンと水をそれぞれお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Payment is complete. Here are the bread and water separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。友達にはパンの袋を渡します。分けてくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二品受領し友人へパン袋を渡すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received them. I'll give my friend the bread bag. Separating them was helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have received both items and will give your friend the bread bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。お連れ様にもよろしくお伝えください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Please give my regards to your friend too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貯金の計画に使うメモをお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have notes for a savings plan, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行で五万円使ったので、毎月の支出にも五万円と書きました。でも、毎月旅行する予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回の旅行五万円を毎月支出と書いた誤りを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I spent fifty thousand yen on a trip, so I put fifty thousand yen in monthly spending too. But I'm not planning to travel every month.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the mistake of listing a one-off fifty-thousand-yen trip as monthly spending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 定期的な支出と、一回の支出を分けて整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can organize regular and one-off expenses separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この旅行は先月だけです。家賃や食費と同じ欄へ足したので、通常の一か月が分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先月だけの旅行を家賃食費と同欄にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That trip was only last month. I added it to the same column as rent and groceries, so I can no longer tell what a normal month looks like.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you put last month's one-off trip in the same column as rent and food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今後の予定も、分かる範囲でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell us what you know about future plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来年も行きたいですが、時期も金額もまだ決めていません。先月と同じ費用が必ず出るとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来年旅行希望はあるが時期費用未定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to go next year too, but haven't decided the timing or cost. I won't write that the same expense as last month will definitely recur.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to travel next year but the timing and cost are undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貯金のご希望は、どのように考えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: What are your wishes for saving?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎月使える分を知りたいです。旅行を全部やめる条件ではなく、別に備える方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全旅行中止でなく通常の余裕と別備えを相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to know how much I have available each month. Rather than make stopping all travel a condition, I'd like to discuss setting money aside for it separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to discuss ordinary monthly flexibility and separate provision rather than stopping all travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の整理後、担当へ計画をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After organizing the materials, you can discuss the plan with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。先月の実績、普段の支出、未決定の旅行を分けます。紙を書き直しただけで毎月の入金を申し込んだとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実績と通常支出と未定予定を分け入金申込とはしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll separate last month's actual spending, ordinary expenses, and undecided travel. I won't assume rewriting the paper means I've applied for monthly deposits.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish actual spending, normal expenses, and undecided plans, and not treat it as a deposit application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談のご希望を担当へつなぎます。それでは、整理した資料をお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-TAKAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer your request for a consultation to the person in charge. Please bring the organized materials. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その布、幅の確認は済みましたか。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked that fabric's width?

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測ったら指示書より広かったです。端の糸が出ている所も含めて測りました。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幅が広く出た測定と房を含めた方法を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I measured it and it was wider than the instructions. I included the parts with threads sticking out at the edges.
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the wide measurement and that your method included the fringe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 房の部分は含めません。織ってある部分の端から端まで測ります。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't include the fringe. Measure from edge to edge of the woven part.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 測る位置を間違えたんですね。ここを端として、布を強く引っ張らずに測ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい端と張力を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I measured from the wrong points. Should I use this as the edge and measure without pulling the fabric hard?
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the correct edges and tension for measuring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。平らに置いてください。今の数値は記録済みですか。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Lay it flat. Have you recorded the current figure yet?

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ下書きだけです。測り直した結果と、最初の測り方を間違えたことを一緒に報告します。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確定記録を測り直し理由付きで報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only in a draft so far. I'll report the remeasurement together with the fact that my first method was wrong.
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will remeasure the unfinalized record and report it with the reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでお願いします。途中だけ幅が違う場合もあるので、三か所を見てください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. The width can differ along the fabric, so check three places.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両端と中央ですね。中央だけ狭かったら、平均にせず、それぞれの数値を書くということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三か所の差を平均で隠さず記録するか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both ends and the middle, correct? If only the middle is narrower, should I write each figure rather than an average?
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether to record the differences at three points rather than conceal them in an average. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。違いがあれば、次の工程へ渡す前に呼んでください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Exactly. If there's a difference, call me before passing it to the next process.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三か所を別々に記録します。幅がそろっているか確認してから、次へ渡してよいか聞きます。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 測定後の引渡し可否を確認すると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record the three places separately. After checking whether the width is consistent, I'll ask whether it can go to the next stage.
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to check permission to hand it over after measuring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この平らな台を使ってください。測定が終わるまで、その布はここに置いておきましょう。
DLG-SC-GNM-KIRYU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this flat table, then. Let's leave the fabric here until measuring is finished.
